metadata.objective: Close RepoNPC Delivery Phase 2 from the owner-approved Git baseline by specifying and implementing the production index CLI, build-time local sentence-transformers adapter, bilingual public profile producer-consumer contract, repository metadata evidence, and a Docker-isolated formal retrieval benchmark while preserving prior evidence and last-known-good behavior.

reasons: The closure crosses the production console entrypoint, bundle publication, public API, provider identity, and benchmark trust boundary.
The owner explicitly authorized Terra, but only a frozen one-production-file/one-test-file embedding leaf is safe under degraded identity verification.

rejected_modes.reason: Public profile, CLI, publication-last, and oracle isolation are critical shared seams and cannot be delegated.

current_state_evidence.observation: The console script resolves to reponpc.main:run, so --help and every workflow subcommand enter deployment startup and fail environment validation.
Only a protocol exists and its docstring explicitly defers concrete adapters; no production local sentence-transformers adapter is shipped.
The route validates locale but returns the same unvalidated profile.json object for zh-TW and en.
The verifier requires only that profile.json decode to an object; it does not validate both locale payloads or the public response fields.
All non-documentation files are classified as source_code, so the real Phase 2 fixture produces zero repository_metadata rows.
The benchmark uses FixtureEmbeddingProvider, reads the controller oracle in the candidate process, does not enforce Docker resource limits, and hardcodes formal_acceptance false.
A real Docker persistence/restart smoke passed on Docker Desktop 4.86.0 / Engine 29.7.2 and remains historical evidence.
Owner-approved audited closure baseline is commit 83c3dd44f7cc2856dc3b61d9f637337f1a466d3e with a clean production tree.

control_flow.path: pyproject.toml -> src/reponpc/cli.py -> src/reponpc/main.py or indexing pipeline
control_flow.failure_path: Argparse returns a nonzero safe error without loading deployment secrets for help/validation failures.

control_flow.path: config -> GitHub resolver -> embedding adapter -> IndexDatabaseBuilder -> public profile -> build_bundle
control_flow.failure_path: Any source, embedding, public-asset, database, or archive failure leaves no completed bundle and cannot advance a manifest.

control_flow.path: bundle -> immutable release asset -> verified pending stable manifest -> stable branch update
control_flow.failure_path: Failure before publish-manifest leaves the previous remote stable manifest unchanged.

control_flow.path: public_profile producer -> archive verifier -> BundleManager active public directory -> GET /api/public/profile
control_flow.failure_path: Missing, invalid, or incomplete locale data rejects the candidate or returns INDEX_UNAVAILABLE; it never cross-falls back.

control_flow.path: host controller oracle -> Docker candidate with public inputs only -> candidate retrieval output -> host scoring
control_flow.failure_path: Any oracle visibility, nonproduction provider, missing resource limit, missing provenance, or threshold miss forces formal_acceptance=false.

interfaces.contract: Build-time adapter identity exactly matches config and manifest; embed_query(list[str]) and embed_passages(list[str]) return finite normalized float32 matrices with the declared dimension. No adapter fallback is permitted.
profile.json schema_version=1 contains exact locales keys zh-TW and en; each locale has profile, repositories, suggested_questions; character and index are shared validated objects.
GET /api/public/profile returns the existing approved schema_version, requested locale, localized profile/repositories/suggested_questions, character, and index fields.
index publish creates/uploads/verifies an immutable asset and writes a local pending manifest; only index publish-manifest may update the remote stable manifest.

Candidate input contains repository fixture, public questions, and adapter/model configuration only; candidate output contains retrieved IDs/paths, timing samples, identity, and access-probe evidence but no expected answers or pass flags.

lifecycle.rule: No arguments and explicit serve both invoke the existing validated server startup exactly once.
The final remote state transition is impossible before immutable verification.
The controller derives all formal booleans after inspecting the stopped candidate container and its output.

state_transitions.transition: verified immutable asset -> pending local manifest -> remote stable manifest
state_transitions.forbidden: remote stable manifest mutation from build or publish before verification

state_transitions.transition: candidate profile and index verified -> active pointer swap
state_transitions.forbidden: activation with one missing locale, invalid profile field, or embedding mismatch

failure_boundaries.safe_result: nonzero exit with stable safe message and no server startup for command failures
bundle candidate rejected or public route returns INDEX_UNAVAILABLE; no locale fallback
prior stable manifest remains byte-for-byte unchanged
formal_acceptance and passed are false with explicit derived blockers
handoff is blocked or rejected when any path outside the adapter/test/artifact scope changes

invariants.statement: Phase 2 indexing and formal evaluation use the shipped local_sentence_transformers adapter with exact identity, finite normalized float32 output, and no fallback.

invariants.statement: One produced profile.json contains complete zh-TW and en payloads, is schema-validated unchanged by the archive verifier, and yields the existing locale-specific public response.

invariants.prohibited_behavior: Returning the same locale payload for both requests or accepting a bundle missing one locale.

invariants.statement: Allowlisted line-addressable root manifests are emitted as REPOSITORY_FACT evidence with source_type repository_metadata and participate in configured retrieval weighting.
invariants.enforcement_owner: IndexDatabaseBuilder source classifier and read-only retrieval policy
invariants.prohibited_behavior: The producer emits zero metadata rows while consumer weights claim support, or classifies owner role/summary as repository facts.
invariants.counterexample: A root pyproject.toml is stored as source_code or an owner-authored role is stored as REPOSITORY_FACT.

invariants.statement: Only publish-manifest mutates the stable pointer, and it can consume only a locally recorded manifest derived from a verified immutable asset.
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Build or publish advances stable-manifest.json before asset verification.
invariants.counterexample: Upload verification fails but the mock records a stable-manifest PUT.

invariants.statement: The candidate container cannot read the oracle, runs the production adapter with 4 CPU and 8 GiB limits, and returns only candidate evidence/timings; the host controller derives formal results and provenance.
invariants.enforcement_owner: host benchmark controller plus Docker mount/resource inspection
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Mounting or baking the oracle into the candidate image, accepting candidate pass flags, or reporting reference_host_verified without inspect evidence.
invariants.counterexample: The candidate can stat /workspace/evals/phase2/controller/expected-evidence.json or report formal_acceptance=true itself.

invariants.statement: Closure changes do not weaken bundle rejection, atomic activation, or preservation of the active bundle on failure.
invariants.enforcement_owner: BundleManager, verifier, updater, and regression gates
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Invalid profile/embedding/publication candidates replace the active bundle or pointer.
invariants.counterexample: A profile missing en activates over a valid current bundle.

invariants.statement: Every closure delta is attributable to the new Git baseline and historical ledgers remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

invariants.prohibited_behavior: Rewriting old failed delta evidence or accepting an unowned worker path.

dispatches.authorization_source: The owner requested a Terra subagent repair and approved the recommended closure plan with '照建議方案'.
dispatches.objective: Implement only the frozen build-time local sentence-transformers adapter and its focused unit tests.
frozen_contracts: Class LocalSentenceTransformersEmbeddingProvider has keyword-only constructor model_id: str, dimension: int, normalized: bool, query_prefix: str, passage_prefix: str, device: str='cpu', batch_size: int=32; identity(), embed_query(list[str]), and embed_passages(list[str]) implement the Main-owned protocol.
identity must be local_sentence_transformers, configured model ID/dimension/prefixes, normalized=true.

embed_query and embed_passages accept raw strings, apply exactly one configured query/passage prefix, and return finite normalized float32 matrices; empty input returns a zero-row matrix with declared width.

The module import is dependency-light; sentence_transformers is imported lazily. Dependency, model-load, encode, and output failures raise EmbeddingProviderError codes embedding_dependency_unavailable, embedding_model_load_failed, embedding_encode_failed, or embedding_output_invalid respectively, without upstream text and without trying another provider/model.

SentenceTransformer loads the configured model once on the configured device with trust_remote_code disabled; encode uses convert_to_numpy=true, normalize_embeddings=true, show_progress_bar=false, and the configured batch size.
